title: Scribe
intro: Tell your AI trader what you heard. It will research the claim and look for prediction-market contracts.
placeholder: A key player may miss tomorrow’s game. Check the report, the matchup, and whether any contracts are worth researching.
timing: Local time. Plan a day ahead, or at least 3 hours. Times are a plan, not scheduled orders.
working: Your AI is researching this tip…
disclaimer: Research first · Paper money only · A tip is not verified evidence
demo: Scribe needs your desktop runner and a signed-in AI. The demo does not generate research.
offline: Connect your desktop runner to use Scribe.
noProvider: Sign in to an AI app on the desktop runner, then reconnect the desk.
empty: Your tips and proposed plays will appear here.
noCandidates: No suitable contract identified. There may be no play here.
paperHint: One paper stake on the prediction desk, at the live book price, held to settlement.
paperEarly: Starts by hand once the expected entry arrives.
paperLate: The expected exit has passed. Research the tip again with a new window.
badTime: Choose an entry at least 3 hours from now and an exit after entry.
failed: Could not reach the runner. Your tip is still in the editor.
